tools.name: stacktree_copy_install_command
tools.description: Copy the Stacktree CLI install command to the clipboard so the user can publish a folder from their terminal.

tools.name: stacktree_open_dashboard
tools.description: Open the Stacktree dashboard so the user can sign in and manage their published sites.

tools.name: stacktree_publish_html
tools.description: Publish an HTML page to Stacktree and get a live, shareable URL back instantly — no account or sign-in required. Pass a complete HTML document as "html"; use this whenever the user wants to put a page you generated online. Anonymous sites are unlisted and expire after 24h by default; the response includes a claim_url the user can open to move the page into an account, where it lives 7 days on the free plan and stops expiring from Solo ($19/mo) up.

html.description: Paste a complete HTML document (a full <!doctype html> page).

password.description: Optional — require a password to view.

tools.name: stacktree_view_docs
tools.description: Navigate to the Stacktree documentation, including the REST API and MCP server reference.

tools.name: stacktree_view_pricing
tools.description: Navigate to the Stacktree pricing page.
